text.name: Sickle of Kronos
text.event: A sickle stands aslant in the silt of an undersea rift, its edge so black that it gives back no light. As you grasp it, the currents around you slow by a beat. This is the Sickle of Kronos.

text.name: Star Veil of Oranos
text.event: A deep blue cloth lies draped over the altar on the summit, and even by day you can see the stars on it drifting slowly. You put it around your shoulders, and the night sky seems to sink lower. This is the Star Veil of Oranos.

text.name: Book of Gaia
text.event: A book grows in the hollow of an old tree. Vines creep out from under the bronze leaves of its cover, wind around your outstretched hand, and slowly let go. This is the Book of Gaia.

text.name: Crown of Rheia
text.event: In an abandoned temple the stone statue of the mother of the gods still wears a golden crown shaped like battlements. You bow to the statue before you take it down. This is the Crown of Rheia.

text.name: Torches of Hekate
text.event: Two crossed torches stand at a three-way crossroads. No one feeds them, yet they burn with a cold white flame. As you draw near, you hear your own footsteps coming down all three roads at once. These are the Torches of Hekate.

text.name: Pelt of Argus
text.event: A herdsman has spread a hide over a rock as his bedding, yet the eye-shaped markings on it turn to follow you as you walk. You trade a bag of gold for it. This is the Pelt of Argus.

text.name: Titans' Treasure
text.event: Deep in a half-collapsed vault sits a bronze chest. The orichalcum ingots and crystals inside are stacked as neatly as if they had been put there yesterday. This is the Titans' Treasure.

text.name: Titan Legacy
text.description:
{Titan Legacy}

+4 Attack, +2 Defense, +3 Spell Power, +4 Knowledge.
Your troops get +1 Speed, +2 Hit Points, +1 Morale and +1 Luck.
Provides 500 gold and 1 Crystal per day, restores 2 extra Spell Points and gives +2 scouting radius.
+10% Echo chance for Atlantean god powers.
Three Aspects: the damage bonus of ascendant troops is increased by a further 10%; in the first round of every battle Sky, Time and Earth are all ascendant.

Combines the Sickle of Kronos, Star Veil of Oranos, Book of Gaia, Crown of Rheia, Torches of Hekate, Pelt of Argus and Titans' Treasure.
(The components are consumed when combined.)
text.event: The seven relics begin to move before you of their own accord: the sickle stands in the middle, and the veil, the book, the crown, the torches, the pelt and the bronze chest circle it in three rings until they fuse into a disc of orichalcum, on which the stars, the hourglass and the leaves each begin to shine. You have obtained the Titan Legacy.

text.name: Cheiroballista
text.description:
{Cheiroballista}

In battle the Cheiroballista shoots at enemy troops, and its damage grows with the hero's Attack. A hero who has learned Artillery can aim it personally.
text.event: An unattended bolt thrower stands by the road, fresh cord still wound on its winch, its wheel ruts leading off towards the distant shore. You have it hauled into your column. This is a Cheiroballista of Atlantis.
